programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL &amp; WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The rare earth
programme.desc: Along the way, Chip and his friends find an island surrounded by a large lake of acid, under the constant threat of eruption of a volcano. In the island lives lanthanide atoms, according to the legend, are awaiting the arrival of a "chosen" to give them acid that prevents them from leaving the island. Chip, thanks to his book, discovers that the volcano emitted a base when mixed with the acid may neutralize and make the dangerous lake in a nice extension of salt water.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The desert
programme.desc: Across a hot desert Chip and the atoms found themselves with a tungsten atom that gives them refuge under a pyramid-shaped building that, until recently, had an ingenious cooling system through which flowed a stream of ammonia in its basement. But now, Dr. No has diverted the flow of ammonia for his own benefit. Chip discovers the point where ammonia diverts and builds a dam that returns to its normal course.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Three
programme.desc: Laa‐Laa has fun counting to three; 1, 2, 3 rabbits, 1, 2, 3 flowers and 1, 2, 3 trees! Laa-Laa even counts three Teletubbies; Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po.

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S1) - Bed
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say bed and we go on a whirlwind word adventure.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S2) - Messy's Mega Power
programme.desc: The Oki-dokis are about to perform when OKIDO runs out of electricity! Anxious that their favourite band might not be able to play, can Messy and his friends find a new way of powering the concert?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Be Brave Bryan
programme.desc: Bryan gets spooked and thinks there's a lake monster lurking in the mists. It'll be Mojo and Bo who have to find the monster... or show Bryan that there's no monster at all!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Promises
programme.desc: Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mum's word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why it's important not to break them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Cheerleading Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggee's cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. There's a big match ahead...

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: Roly needs a wee, but the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Hey Quacky!
programme.desc: Worm and Ladybird wonder what's going on at Squirrel Club. There's a gorilla playing drums, some helpful ducks, a hot frog, four goats and a hospital run by chicken doctors.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Frog Song
programme.desc: It's fun on the counting train until Naughty Monkey starts to drive! Ethel makes a shape, Frog drops beats with a ribbit song, and Enid turns into anime to chase after a mouse.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - The Sphinx, Egypt
programme.desc: Glitch and the Grimbots are on holiday in Egypt where the Grimbots bury the Great Sphinx in sand, leaving only its head showing.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Hospital
programme.desc: Doctor Bluey is needed when Dad gets a very curious x-ray from Nurse Bingo. It seems he has a cat in his tummy!

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Squash
programme.desc: When dad and Uncle Stripe play a game of squash, Bluey and Bingo are in control of their every move, and Bingo proves that big siblings don't always beat little siblings.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Phones
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Pavlova
programme.desc: Mum won't let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Café in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures (S1) - Andy and the Purple Swamphen
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to the wetlands of Thailand on a global adventure in search of purple swamphens and discover they eat invasive snails.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Star
programme.desc: Bella and Lift are visited by a shining star and set off to explore the floors of Playtime Towers. The first stop is Sketch in Boxtropolis - what will she be making today?

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Eating Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having a picnic and notice that the chickens eat differently than they do. Duggee has his eating badge and can explain all the different ways animals eat.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Dream Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing, but they can't stop thinking about the dreams they had last night. Duggee has his dream badge, so can he help the squirrels work out what their dreams mean.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Rainbow Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels see a rainbow for the very first time, but it disappears so quickly! Together they decide to create a rainbow themselves from everything around them.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Caernarfon Castle, Wales
programme.desc: How will the Go Jetters retrieve Xuli's treasured 'Academy Ace' flying trophy from Caernarfon Castle?

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Mount Rushmore, USA
programme.desc: When the Grimbots add Glitch's face to those of the presidents on Mount Rushmore they cause a major mudslide.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S23) - Too Loud, Thomas!
programme.desc: After Thomas loses his voice, he must find a new way to pass on a very important message.

programme.desc: Sarah and Duck go to the aquarium to track down a waving fish.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Cake Decorate

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Three
programme.desc: Laa‐Laa has fun counting to three; 1, 2, 3 rabbits, 1, 2, 3 flowers and 1, 2, 3 trees! Laa-Laa even counts three Teletubbies; Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: The young Chen Chi-chin (Liu Yung) loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten (Lo Lieh). His father loses at cards and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons seven fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance. Much more than a gambling film, this is a thrilling melting pot of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, poker-face vengeance, and all sorts of edge-of-your-seat gambling duels.

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Kung Fu legend Ti Lung stars in the action movie as Fu Xue Hong, embarking on a epic journey of revenge for his father.

programme.title: Portrait In Crystal
programme.desc: Tragic deaths in the underworld cause leader "Yama" (Teng Wei-hao) to suspect a portrait in crystal with mysterious powers. He sends Hen Pan (Chen Hung) and Pai Pan (Hung Hsin-nan) to interrogate its creator, martial artist Lung Fei (Pai Piao)...

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: Cat VS Rat
programme.desc: Zhan and Bai are equally matched in martial arts skills. Bai saves the Emperor one day but did not believe in his identity and rejects a promotion. When Zhan is promoted to the royal guard after saving the Emperor, Bai gets angry and tries to prank him by stealing the imperial jade seal. Luckily, Zhan is able to retrieve the seal with his skills.

programme.title: Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: Wang Chung was a valued actor long before he became a director, but as a filmmaker, he helped create some of the most interesting thrillers Shaw Brothers ever released - including this fascinating crime saga of a Sino-Vietnamese crime gang. Danny Lee stars as a misunderstood refugee while Ray Lui plays a cop struggling against his own conscience to ensure that justice is upheld.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: Third Master is a renowned swordsman in the martial arts world, but the constant challenges by other swordsmen compel him to fake his death and pursue a secluded life. This does not prevent others from seeking him out to challenge him however, and he is forced to return to fight his way till the end.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another victim instead of the groom is shot, and he becomes a scapegoat in this mystery assassination.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: My Rebellious Son
programme.desc: A corrupt official attempts to steal a priceless Buddha statue from a temple to please a group of Westerners. Luckily, Doctor Zhang and his son manage to defeat the Western boxers, the Japanese Kendo opponents and the Western longsword fighters with Chinese kung fu, thus saving the Buddha statue.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile. The Clan sends various assassins to kill him but failed. They then assigned Kung's brother Yong to find and kill Kung, leading to a battle between the two brothers.

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Brothers from the Walled City
programme.desc: Two orphaned brothers growing up in Kowloon's Walled City - the place where people are forced to live with indecent businesses of sex, gambling and drugs controlled by triads - take very different life paths. Chin works at a cabaret but keeps away from sins, while Kang is drawn to the sleazy underworld. Are their destinies shaped by the "walls"?

programme.title: The Kid with the Golden Arm
programme.desc: The government hires Yang to escort a cargo of gold to a famine stricken area. The vicious Chi Sha gang, with one of their best fighters, Golden Arm, announce their intention to hijack it by killing one of Yang's employees. As Yang gathers his own team of reputable fighters to protect his cargo, are they strong enough to hold off Golden Arm?

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolin's Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hung's son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents' kung fu styles.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Murder Plot
programme.desc: Martial artist Shen Lang is in discussions with kung fu experts from the other six sects to plot the downfall of the traitorous Happy King when his fiancee suddenly disrupts them and Shen has to quickly bring her away. As they continue to pursue the Happy King, both Shen and his fiancee accidentally fall into a trap set up by the King.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Dirty Ho
programme.desc: Master Wang, who is actually the 11th prince, poses as an antique connoisseur to hide his true identity. When he meets Dirty Ho, a witty con artist, Wang knows he has found the right man to help him untangle a royal succession plot...

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: Killer Darts
programme.desc: A group of bandits raided the village where dart master Liu lives and killed his wife. While hunting them down, Liu's disciple kills a farmer and his wife when she refuses his advances, leading Liu to adopt their orphaned daughter and raises her with his son. Years later, the daughter meets a man with the bandits and is tricked to go against Liu.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chen's past insult.

programme.title: Oath Of Death
programme.desc: Three Sung loyalists become blood brothers to fight the tyranny of the Tartar invaders. To oust the oppressors altogether, Ma releases the kidnapped Tartar princess in a strategic effort to gain points with the invaders, but it soon becomes apparent that he desires both a great position and power, and will do anything to get it...

programme.title: Oath Of Death
programme.desc: Three Sung loyalists become blood brothers to fight the tyranny of the Tartar invaders. To oust the oppressors altogether, Ma releases the kidnapped Tartar princess in a strategic effort to gain points with the invaders, but it soon becomes apparent that he desires both a great position and power, and will do anything to get it...

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Linda's tragic suicide.

programme.title: The Tigress Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Sam is being hunted as he discovers that the mayor and the chief of medical bureau are colluding with a drug dealer. He is saved by a fishermen family and works in their friend's grocery but the grocery owner is killed when the enemies track Sam down. Sam escapes to Shaolin to learn the cudgel style of kung fu in order to avenge his friends.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: Two feuding princes fight for the throne in the Qing Dynasty, causing many injuries and deaths to the commoners. Can the lady assassin who is drawn into this royal feud execute her assassination mission in time to help one of the princes secure the throne?

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiance Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan...

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer
programme.desc: The charm of Pursuit Of A Killer lies in the long awaited reunion of Five Venoms duo, Lo Meng and Sun Chien; Lo Meng, who plays a Mainland Chinese criminal escapee to Hong Kong in search of a better life, and a cop (Sun Chien) who helps him adjust to Hong Kong life while tracking down his mysterious killer at the same time.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the "Little Lark" in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesn't care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dupe to get it.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness &amp; innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: Three young men offend a billionaire and are drawn into a high stakes bet. If they win, they get to keep the billionaire's Rolls Royce. Otherwise, they will need to pay the rich man fifty thousand dollars! Will the underdogs win the bet?

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed; and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.desc: Stay tuned to CCTV-4 as we introduce you to the various content and programming on the channel.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, Fat is a gangster who suffers from amnesia. Believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters’ best ally. To complicate matters further, a gangster named Wind, who looks exactly like Fat, starts a turf war with Big Bro.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong’s biggest stars

programme.title: Deep in the Sea
programme.desc: Suspended psychiatrist Huang is asked to treat Zhao who suffers from schizophrenia. Zhao can only release himself from the pain of his girlfriend's death by killing people in his delusion. During the treatment, Huang is gradually affected by Zhao. He soon finds the way to cure Zhao, but then discovers an important secret about himself.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: City of Desire
programme.desc: Sister 13 returns to Macau after 17 years to succeed her father’s underground empire, the prostitution business. She tries to stop their exploitation of the sex workers, but Macau’s economy flourished after the handover, propelling the prostitution and gambling businesses. The city is blinded by desire and Sister 13 can do nothing to help...

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder happens, and the suspects get killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy over two generations.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi’s husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law’s affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother’s death?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife’s debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Love and Let Love!
programme.desc: Cliff proposes to his girlfriend Terry but is killed in a car accident before she says "yes". Terry is devastated and inconsolable. When Cliff's ghost returns, they seem to go back to their good old days. However, Cliff is determined to help Terry get over his death and start anew.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&amp;B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that was planned for years and has to use his skills as an assassin to solve whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - The Shattered King
programme.desc: While Jim and Toby search for dates to the Spring Dance the team searches for the Second Triumbric Stone in the marshlands of the Quagawumps.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Airheads
programme.desc: When Jim is unavailable to do a simple Trollhunter task Toby and Claire take on the responsibility to prove they can carry their weight... literally.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Giant Haboob
programme.desc: Cleve Kelso breaks Rafaela Moreno and a dangerous, cybernetic prisoner named Matsuo Mori from a high-security ice prison. Back in LA, Tony and the crew experience a major shake-up when Echo gets accepted to Ms. Nowhere’s spy training but Tony is rejected. While Tony is grappling with his identity crisis, Echo struggles to survive spy school, and Ms. Nowhere and Gary disappear in a massive North African storm during their hunt for Cleve. Echo must lead the Toretto crew and finish Ms.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Dead End
programme.desc: The team travels to Nihaya, or "The Dead End," in their pursuit of Nowhere’s mission. Unfortunately they run into some of Layla’s spurned former criminal partner Sandocal, who steals the kids’ cars for revenge on Layla. With Frostee, Cisco, and Echo held captive, Tony and Layla drive for Sandocal in a dune buggy race to win back their crew’s freedom.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Empty Well
programme.desc: The kids are low on supplies in the Sahara and stumble on a town with a well that has mysteriously run dry. The crew decides to investigate and discovers a Cleve Kelso-controlled water facility that’s stealing water from the village. They manage to blow up the facility, but it alerts Rafaela and Matsuo to their whereabouts.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S2 - Scrapbookmobile Troll Rangers
programme.desc: When Biggie accidentally destroys a beloved scrapbook, he and Poppy set out to replace it by having a scrapbook-worthy adventure. CJ Suki and Priscilla embark on a journey to earn Junior Troll Ranger patches for mastering Trolly activities.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - The Rival Racer
programme.desc: A swift new recruit joins the school racing team, putting Lucky's dreams of riding out front in jeopardy. Pru and Abigail clash over a class project.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S3 - The Ruins
programme.desc: As the journey home continues, Pidge picks up a Blades distress signal, which the Paladins follow to a post-apocalyptic planet

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Liam The Hero
programme.desc: In order to get a ticket to a Manga convention she desperately wants, Birch agrees to write a series of Manga strips featuring Liam as a suave, cool and heroic character. When Birch finally gets a chance to sit down and talk to her hero, he turns out to be a jerk.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - True Colors
programme.desc: When Raffi joins Amelia's rock band, Birch follows on his heels as the band's manager. Soon she's writing songs that pit her and Raffi against their podmates. Pod 4's true colors are revealed once Birch realizes she's gone too far.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Love Lessons
programme.desc: Liam's role as romance advisor to the boys of Cosmos High gets under Birch's skin. Offended that Liam thinks female behaviour is nothing more than a collection of symbols, Birch watches as Liam misinterprets Sandra's signals and ends up with pie on his face.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Miss President
programme.desc: Birch runs for school president because she wants to see changes to the Art program at Cosmos High. On a whim, Liam gets involved and soon his goofy antics are winning him favours. Before long, it's an all-out game of one-upmanship between the two cousins

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Painting Practice
programme.desc: Fifi wants to repaint her kitchen but Poppy has run out of paint. Can anybody else come up with an idea to brighten up her walls?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Hide And Squeak
programme.desc: The twins are playing hide and seek with Pip but they all argue over who is the best at hiding? Can they make up their differences and play nicely together?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - King Stingo
programme.desc: Aunt Tulip has lost Grubby again. When Stingo finds him, he asks to be made King as a reward. It isn't long before he has gone too far and the tots are all fed up with his demands. Can Fifi get life in the garden back to normal?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Hide And Seek
programme.desc: The tots are playing hide and seek and the winner will get Fifi's delicious jam tarts. Who will win, Stingo and Slugsy are sure it will be them!

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - My Friend Fifi
programme.desc: Fifi and Bumble fall out in a big way after Fifi doesn't show up to the picnic they are supposed to have together. How strange that Stingo is trying to get them to be friends again, or is it?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Diggly's Big Adventure
programme.desc: Diggly is bored of life on his compost heap and wants to see round the rest of the garden. Fifi offers to give him a guided tour. Diggly gets lost, how will he get home?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Pip's Playground
programme.desc: Pip is feeling bored and wants something new to play. Fifi has a brilliant idea and asks all the tots to help her build a playground for Pip as a surprise.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Mud Sculptures
programme.desc: It has been raining and the garden is muddy. The tots decide to make mud sculptures. But what will they all do with the sculptures when they are finished?

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Paints A Mural
programme.desc: Olivia is inspired after a visit to the museum with her family, and decides she's going to become a great painter herself. She gets right down to business, painting a portrait of Ian. When she sees a mural painting on a building wall, she wonders if she'll ever find a space big enough for her big ideas!

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia And Her Ducklings
programme.desc: After a fun day at the park, Olivia and Ian return home with some unexpected visitors - a mother duck and her ducklings! The harder Olivia and Ian try to keep he ducks a secret from Mother and Father, the more household mischief they all seem to get into.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Puff Enuf
programme.desc: The Riders find a Puffertail and train her to join the family. She struggles to learn but soon finds herself with a chance to make a big rescue.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Birthday Blues
programme.desc: Missing his old life on his birthday, Boss tries to have a full-fledged grown-up celebration in Chicago, but Carol is the only one able to chauffeur and take care of him. The two battle at every stop of the birthday party tour, but when Boss's old work nemesis sets him up for an Federal Investigation Sting at an improv comedy show, Boss and Carol are forced to work together to escape the law.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Sitting Ducks
programme.desc: Boss, Tina, JJ, Dez and Pip willfully get babysat by the Uncuddleables, planning to expose them as horrible sitters via secret, hidden cameras. But the plan is thrown for a loop when Tina's first night alone without her parents makes her fall for their sitter Mia as a "substitute mommy." Meanwhile, Nannycam uses the babysitting distraction to sneak into the Uncuddleables' secret garage hideout to gather intel with her own "B field team."

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Strange Strife of the Smelly Socktopus
programme.desc: After Erica convinces them that being suspended is a great vacation, George and Harold pull off every prank they can think of in order to get suspended

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Flustering Mindless Woe of the Flushable Memory Wipes
programme.desc: After being made fun of for sitting in chocolate pudding, George and Harold go into hiding only to come back to find that everybody has forgotten who they are

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Escape from L.A.
programme.desc: Tony and his crew have been working as spy racers in LA for a while now and are itching to go international. Whey they discover a mysterious man with a strange tattoo of a formula in a smuggling ring bust, Ms. Nowhere finally agrees to let them go to Rio to investigate the tattoo and the whereabouts of one of her agents who has gone dark - Layla Gray.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - That Sinking Feeling
programme.desc: Ms. Nowhere drops the kids off in Brazil and leaves to go on her own important mission, but things immediately go south for Tony and his crew. When the hauler and gear gets caught in quicksand, Tony needs to learn that a good leader knows when to accept help.

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP30
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: Golden Bowl - EP8
programme.desc: Man’s Noodles is passed down to the current generation. Man Shui (Raymond Cho), Man Nin (Hugo Wong) and Man Sai (Mark Ma) have learned the craft from their father and opened their own noodle shops. However, three shops on the same street have resulted in destructive competition. Lung Kau (Mayanne Mak), Fok Siu-yuk (Ashley Chu) and Kam Chi (Kamen Kong) are their wives respectively. They often quarrel as they earnestly defend their husbands.

programme.title: The Runner - EP10
programme.desc: Web media editor Ho Ka-yan (Elaine Yiu) encounters track and field coach Yuen Nik (Joel Chan) as she is assigned the task of approaching the Windchasers Club and digging up scandalous dirt. Because of some past regrettable incident, Yuen Nik avoids socializing with other people. But he is getting closer and closer to Ka-yan as he repeatedly mingles with her. Kwok Bui-yee (Tiffany Lau), daughter of tycoon Kwok Wong-po (Ram Chiang), eagerly joins Windchasers as she has some ulterior motive.

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP36
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: Law dis-Order - EP10
programme.desc: As the founder of the leading Chinese law firm, CHEUK KAI-YIU (Lau Dan) has been re-elected as chairman of the committee for many terms. Though he promised managing partner LAU KING-CHANG (Liu Kai Chi) that he would step down, he deliberately brings in a materialistic lawyer called CHEUNG KEUNG (Alex Fong) to counterbalance KING-CHANG's obsession with power.

programme.title: The Silver Chamber Of Sorrows - EP2
programme.desc: "Sheung’s Silver Chamber", the largest jewel company in Foshan, Guangdong Province China, is facing serious financial difficulties. In order to obtain a loan from SHUM’s family, SHEUNG HANG (Chun Pui), owner of the Chamber, together with his primary wife, CHOI SIU-DIP (Sit Ka Yin), plot to arrange marriage between SHEUNG WAN (Ng Wai Kwok), HANG’s younger brother, and SHUM WING-TUNG (Young Yuen Yee), daughter of SHUM’s family.

programme.title: Hello Missfortune - EP7
programme.desc: In a multidimensional domain, Poon Siu-yu (Erica Chan) enters the second dimension after her death in the first dimension, i.e. the mortal realm. She then joins Office of the Life Authority and becomes a novice "destiny administrator". Siu-yu has to keep a close watch on food courier Chan Pei-ho (Hubert Wu), who is in the mortal realm. Pei-ho earns a meager living regardless of the weather. But his family members just do not care about him.

programme.title: Pages Of Treasures - EP10
programme.desc: Bookshop staff FONG HOK MAN (Chun Pui) always believes that "knowledge is power". He tries hard to encourage his older son FONG SUM MING (Lai Yiu Cheung) and his younger son FONG SUM CHING (Suen Eric) to study more. Unfortunately, MING is not good at studying at all and he quits after secondary school. On the other hand, CHING is a very smart boy and MING works hard overseas to support CHING’s further studies on computer sciences in America.

programme.title: The Legend Of Master Chai - EP3
programme.desc: In Heaven, Chai (Leung Wing Chun) killed Huen (Ho Po Sang) over a pot of sweet lotus seed soup. He was expelled to earth to suffer, while at the same time, he had to help Huen and Nui, who were also sent down to earth, to regain their powers._x000D__x000D_Chai was punished to become the stupid and shabby son, of an earthly man. Huen, on the other hand, was his handsome and clever brother, who was loved by all. One day, Chai regained his magic power and started to challenge Huen.

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP31
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: Brick Slaves - EP1
programme.desc: LAU YIU-MING (Vincent Wong) exhausts the money that he and his girlfriend have saved for many years to buy a property and is about to get married. Out of the blue, his girlfriend not only wants to break up with him, but also secretly leases the premises out to a piano teacher, CHOI KIN-CHING (Selena Li). Unfortunately, YIU-MING's bad day gets even worse as he is soon laid off from work.

programme.title: The Runner - EP11
programme.desc: Web media editor Ho Ka-yan (Elaine Yiu) encounters track and field coach Yuen Nik (Joel Chan) as she is assigned the task of approaching the Windchasers Club and digging up scandalous dirt. Because of some past regrettable incident, Yuen Nik avoids socializing with other people. But he is getting closer and closer to Ka-yan as he repeatedly mingles with her. Kwok Bui-yee (Tiffany Lau), daughter of tycoon Kwok Wong-po (Ram Chiang), eagerly joins Windchasers as she has some ulterior motive.

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP37
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: Law dis-Order - EP12
programme.desc: As the founder of the leading Chinese law firm, CHEUK KAI-YIU (Lau Dan) has been re-elected as chairman of the committee for many terms. Though he promised managing partner LAU KING-CHANG (Liu Kai Chi) that he would step down, he deliberately brings in a materialistic lawyer called CHEUNG KEUNG (Alex Fong) to counterbalance KING-CHANG's obsession with power.

programme.desc: 時間來到2012年，彩香邁入六十六歲，什麼都不缺。財富自由、身體堪用、愛情穩定，不受孩子牽絆，發貴小鷗為伴，可說是「六六大順」。以為晚年就這樣了，但…天外竟飛來一哥的老母親，彩香的人生進入番外篇，扮起她人生沒扮過的角色：媳婦。

programme.title: 阿叔第16集
programme.desc: 王文欽從小住在嘉義朴子，是當地唯一的「木工傢俱修復師」，傳承老一輩的工匠精神，文欽做事認真，初戀沒有開花結果的他，一生未娶，獨力撫養姪子姪女。他不僅修復破損的傢俱，更看見歷史的痕跡和故事。而他深切希望修復自己的老家，找回失落的傢俱，延續家族的回憶。 文欽的初戀情人紀明珠從臺北回到嘉義朴子，揭開了文欽不為人知的過去與隱藏的祕密。其後兩人開始重新找尋新的情感模式，修復了心中那些被時間模糊的回憶和情感。文欽用他的技藝和愛心，修復人們與自己心中的缺憾，並帶來了希望與溫暖

programme.title: 生命醫視界第2集
programme.desc: 生命醫視界

programme.title: 豆腐媽媽第18集
programme.desc: 一部以傳統手工豆腐為核心的戲劇，將故事將圍繞著「萬家」的豆腐老店，雖然看似平凡，卻因為「一個家庭三個姓氏」以及「豆腐祕方只傳姓萬的男丁」的家訓，埋下了充滿衝突與矛盾的伏筆。

programme.title: 民視晚間新聞
programme.desc: 民視提供即時政治、國際、財經、生活、社會、地方、娛樂最真實的報導、最多元的內容，掌握最新消息、生活動態，都在民視新聞。

programme.title: 豬哥亮經典秀第18集
programme.desc: 《豬哥亮經典秀》不僅帶給觀眾歡樂和笑聲，還有許多社會關懷的元素。豬哥亮通過喜劇的形式，闡述對社會現象和人情世故的觀察和思考。他的幽默風格融入了對生活的態度和智慧，使節目更具意義和價值。《豬哥亮經典秀》在臺灣電視界享有很高的評價和知名度，成為了豬哥亮的代表作之一。這個節目也讓豬哥亮贏得了許多獎項和觀眾的喜愛，並在他逝世後成為了他不朽的精神財富。

programme.title: 綜藝大集合第1257集
programme.desc: 由胡瓜領軍主持的民視綜藝強檔，其中「壽星大發生日快樂」單元幫不少藝人找到了許久不見的親人、朋友及恩人，感人的故事常讓觀眾看得淚流滿面。 全新企劃「綜藝大集合水上大作戰」！

programme.title: 阿叔第17集
programme.desc: 王文欽從小住在嘉義朴子，是當地唯一的「木工傢俱修復師」，傳承老一輩的工匠精神，文欽做事認真，初戀沒有開花結果的他，一生未娶，獨力撫養姪子姪女。他不僅修復破損的傢俱，更看見歷史的痕跡和故事。而他深切希望修復自己的老家，找回失落的傢俱，延續家族的回憶。 文欽的初戀情人紀明珠從臺北回到嘉義朴子，揭開了文欽不為人知的過去與隱藏的祕密。其後兩人開始重新找尋新的情感模式，修復了心中那些被時間模糊的回憶和情感。文欽用他的技藝和愛心，修復人們與自己心中的缺憾，並帶來了希望與溫暖

programme.title: 綜藝大集合第1257集
programme.desc: 由胡瓜領軍主持的民視綜藝強檔，其中「壽星大發生日快樂」單元幫不少藝人找到了許久不見的親人、朋友及恩人，感人的故事常讓觀眾看得淚流滿面。 全新企劃「綜藝大集合水上大作戰」！

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視臺定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視臺的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 名人書房第87集
programme.desc: 閱讀引導我們漫步在別人的思想與靈魂當中13位名人的讀書故事，13段動人的奇幻旅程~繼2015年與中天電視合作製播《名人牀頭書》節目，邀請39位名人深度分享閱讀帶來的影響及美好，冠德玉山教育基金會於2018年起獨立製作《名人書房》影片，以閱讀為主題的實景記錄，期待能呈現文學、藝術、設計、空間等風格意義，邀請王偉忠、五月天/石頭、江坤俊、姚謙、郎祖筠、許芳宜、郭重興、曾文誠、曾寶儀、鄭豐、徐薇X大成、劉安婷X呂冠緯等跨界名人，由資深主播詹慶齡擔任主持人，在漫漫的引言互動中，侃侃而談對生命的感知、閱讀經驗的分享與追夢的過程。影片片頭「名人書房」由《每日一字》書法家張炳煌揮毫，配樂為大提琴家呂超倫演奏

programme.title: 唐獎紀錄片第19集
programme.desc: 唐獎共設有永續發展、生技醫藥、漢學、法治等諾貝爾獎未及涵蓋的領域，藉由設立獎項鼓勵專業人才投入探索21世紀人類所需要的智慧，以頂尖的研究成果及社會實踐引領全人類發展。

programme.title: 人生調色盤-愛瑞克
programme.desc: 人生調色盤-愛瑞克

programme.title: 與匠同行第8集
programme.desc: 影像工作者馮復華走訪臺灣各地，拍攝《與匠同行》，記錄臺灣廟宇傳承百年的雕刻、剪黏、堆花、水墨彩繪等匠師藝術，為他們精湛的手藝留下保存紀錄，並分享由記者轉職影像創作的心路歷程。

programme.title: 樂樂的飛行圖書館第8集
programme.desc: 歡迎來到樂樂的飛行圖書館！樂樂是一個來自小行星的小主人，他收藏了無數好書。在這裡，有快樂、驚險、懸疑、搞笑等各式各樣的故事等著你。樂樂邀請作家和老師來圖書館，和你分享他們的故事，你也可以提問討論。現在就進來樂樂的飛行圖書館，一起展開奇幻又有趣的閱讀冒險吧！讓我們和樂樂一起飛翔，探索屬於我們的故事世界！

programme.title: 臺灣神話故事第8集
programme.desc: 最愛說故事的王叔叔，帶著小朋友用臺語認識臺灣土地的傳奇故事!

programme.title: 梵音清流第6集
programme.desc: 此音只應天上有，人間哪得幾回聞。」「梵唄」就是清淨之意，除了耳根享受之外，最主要的仍在心靈的清淨，歌詠時還伴以管、弦或敲擊樂器，普及佛教教義。

programme.title: 幸福食堂第252集

programme.title: 三好微電影第七屆世界影展第5集
programme.desc: 三好微電影第七屆世界影展

programme.title: 百年巨匠-李可染
programme.desc: 《百年巨匠》是一部大規模、全方位拍攝製作的關於近代藝術大師、畫壇巨匠的大型人物傳記系列紀錄片，用獨特的影視鏡頭語言對20世紀中國畫壇上最具影響力的藝術巨匠進行的全方位的影像解讀和人物詮釋。動人心絃、精彩紛呈的人物故事，再現了一代藝術大師真實生動、極富傳奇色彩的人生歷程。故事起伏跌宕，感人至深，具有不可多得的文獻價值和賞心悅目的審美價值。

programme.title: 從「業力論」談光明在望-心定和尚
programme.desc: 從「業力論」談光明在望-心定和尚

programme.title: 生活智多星第1571集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－鬱方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，瞭解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關喫的大哉問：喫進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，喫的順序、喫的方法與喫的健康，從不喫壞肚子到喫到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.title: 生活智多星第1562集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－鬱方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，瞭解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關喫的大哉問：喫進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，喫的順序、喫的方法與喫的健康，從不喫壞肚子到喫到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.title: 人間新聞

programme.title: 行動現場第428集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
臺灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散佈各鄉鎮村裏，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平臺，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.title: 青春愛讀書第395集

programme.title: 證嚴上人說故事第246集
programme.desc: 聽故事，曾經是兒時最大的期待。好聽的故事，更是百聽不厭、刻骨銘心。 《證嚴上人說故事》是證嚴上人從多年生活歷練中摘取得來的智慧結晶。在一則則風趣淺白故事中，她告訴我們，在生命的經營裡，如果被『名』枷『利』鎖綁住，而失去心靈空間，那將是一種無法彌補的損失。

programme.title: 風月同天第13集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集

programme.title: 風月同天第17集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 大愛真健康第882集
programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身、增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實。 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三~五分鐘時間，跟著「大愛真健康」做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕、愈動愈健康！

programme.title: 映照人生第491集
programme.desc: 印尼，是個超過兩億人口的東南亞大國，貧富差距極大，且語言文化種族差異均大。由印尼大愛臺製作的「映照人生」，報導當地各面向的社會議題，從2010年起逐年獲獎，被譽為是印尼正面紀錄片的先驅之一。 製作團隊都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地觀點，對印尼社會做深度觀察，發現問題，報導當事人如何解決或面對，製作出一系列感人且啟發人心的故事，傳達以人道為關懷精神的節目內容。 本節目記錄著印尼底層的人們，每個勇敢迎向苦難與希望的故事；也帶領觀眾看見，這個世界的黑暗角落，因為人性的光輝，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 草根菩提第4028集
programme.desc: 有一羣人用他們的生活響應 證嚴上人「用鼓掌雙手做環保」的理念；在他們身上，環保居然可以和生活這麼地貼近，而不是遙不可及的觀念、數字或儀器。這是一羣很特別的人，他們無時無刻都在想著如何讓我們所住的地球更美好。

programme.title: 大愛全紀實第168集
programme.desc: 慈濟四大八法推廣與傳播,關注地球與人類永續發展議題。 解讀近代事件中，慈濟「曾經」參與的足跡，至今「正在」持續的行動，以及留給「未來」的影響力。 為觀眾傳播慈濟四大八法，剖析探討慈濟人如何關注地球永續發展、推動拔苦予樂的希望工程。

programme.title: 人文講堂第557集
programme.desc: 《人文講堂》節目，邀請臺灣各行各業傑出人士、學者專家，或熱愛生命者，將多年的學識涵養、人文感受，以及對生命的活力，以講演方式，直接與大眾分享。講演的內容及方式，不再流於傳統，不僅是知識或專業技術而已，更會呈現出特有的人文觀點。

programme.title: 365日日素第240集

programme.desc: 證嚴上人慈示：「新聞報導，除了『報』，還要進一步『導』，範疇要開闊，關懷普天下蒼民，為時代作見證，為人類寫歷史。」，大愛新聞透過SNG、電話連線、數位影像，傳遞全球最新訊息，堅持將人間美善訊息與人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，發揮淨化人心功能。

programme.title: 行動現場第454集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
臺灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散佈各鄉鎮村裏，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平臺，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.title: 行動現場第454集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
臺灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散佈各鄉鎮村裏，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平臺，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 慶餘年第1集
programme.desc: 某大學文學史專業的學生張慶（張若昀飾）熟讀古典名著，但他用現代觀念剖析古代文學史，透過寫小說的方式，進一步闡述自己想要表達的觀點。在他的小說中，身世神祕的少年範閑，自小跟隨奶奶生活在海邊小城澹州，隨著一位自稱老師的突然造訪，他看似平靜的生活開始直面重重的危機與考驗。上半部的劇情主要發生在京都，範閑追查牛欄街刺殺一案的幕後黑手。下半部劇情發生在北齊上京城，範閑親率南慶使團，前往北齊用戰犯肖恩交換言冰雲。但這只是，慶帝和陳萍萍佈局，想令肖恩誤以為範閑就是他失散多年的孫子，藉此套出神廟的祕密。

programme.title: MIT臺灣誌第651集
programme.desc: 《MIT臺灣誌》是為臺灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為臺灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT臺灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT臺灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT臺灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了臺灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自臺灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 全民星攻略第1145集
programme.desc: 中視推出懸疑益智實境節目《全民星攻略》！由幽默風趣「慧黠」的《館長》-曾國城，引領明星、名人、網紅，全民進擊「九宮格攻略賽」，過關奪大獎！ 最懸疑緊張的過關氛圍、最詼諧爆笑的「爾虞我詐」 ！最貼近「人生」的智慧題庫！敬請準時一起來挑戰-《全民星攻略》！

programme.title: 中視午間新聞第22集
programme.desc: 「中視午間新聞」每天以最客觀的角度，最專業的主播，為觀眾完整報導上午發生之重大國內外重要新聞，並提供最新股市收盤價格。

programme.title: 綜藝一級棒第87集
programme.desc: 希望在最美好的舞臺上，給大家帶來滿滿歡樂時光！

programme.title: 全民星攻略第1172集
programme.desc: 中視推出懸疑益智實境節目《全民星攻略》！由幽默風趣「慧黠」的《館長》-曾國城，引領明星、名人、網紅，全民進擊「九宮格攻略賽」，過關奪大獎！ 最懸疑緊張的過關氛圍、最詼諧爆笑的「爾虞我詐」 ！最貼近「人生」的智慧題庫！敬請準時一起來挑戰-《全民星攻略》！

programme.title: 綜藝玩很大第562集
programme.desc: ｢綜藝玩很大｣由亞洲娛樂天王吳宗憲、小鬼黃鴻升主持， 每集任務關卡無極限，來賓個個拚得你死我活， 不只玩很大，更跟你玩真的， 到底藝人們為了輸贏能多犧牲？ 中視週六晚上10點【綜藝玩很大】

programme.title: 大陸尋奇第2111集
programme.desc: 大陸尋奇是臺灣目前最社教節目之冠不惜巨資的大製作足跡踏遍各現代城市、窮鄉僻壤，深入各民族村落，記錄了外人難得一見的生活情況，以準確的地理、歷史定位，用現代化思維，把中華文化忠實的呈現。 漫遊在浩瀚中國的世外桃源，細賞湖光山色間的粉妝玉琢，帶您跋山涉水遊遍奇峯峻嶺，讓您看盡壯闊山河嘆為觀止。

programme.title: 中視新聞全球報導第22集
programme.desc: 中視每晚七點由主播哈遠儀為全國觀眾最專業、準確的新聞報導。

programme.title: 飢餓遊戲第404集
programme.desc: 每天都是新的挑戰，你永遠不知道下一關會和誰合作，所以只能帶著「持續遊戲、持續進食」的心態，努力獲得食物來滿足飢餓，直到飢餓指數歸零，這樣才能成為最終的勝利者！

programme.title: 驚奇旅明星第5集
programme.desc: 讓女明星們在旅途中體驗人生，激活她們的內心，創造屬於她們的心靈之旅！給這些年約40的女明星在已經事業有成的平淡生活中，一段有驚喜感的旅遊，要先好好愛自己，好好體會人生，纔能有愛人與被愛的勇氣。

programme.title: 霹靂靖玄錄下闋第3集
programme.desc: 皇禍再起，逆世雙鱗重磅襲捲南域，焚夜天祭，風月主人召喚火隕滅世，昔日劫難再次降臨，軒昂五璣各自傷亡，儒道頂峯身無餘力，傳說中的恆山．劍謫仙，如今身在何處？他能再現江湖，扛起蒼生這面大旗嗎？

programme.title: 霹靂謎城之九輪異譜第43集
programme.desc: 講述了六王開天已破局，怪販妖市之中的恩怨情仇即將終結。然而，異識亂禍，神祕的魔吞不動城突然現世，九輪天蠢蠢欲動，世局傾危，魔吞天下。

programme.title: 天子傳奇第10集
programme.desc: 商朝第二十八代君－紂王，好大喜功，徵戰連連，百姓為其榷稅徵租，貧乏窮困，哀聲載道，民心漸失。一日在平魔的慶功宴時，代表大商國運的鎮國龍龜猝亡，適時西現紫氣，紂王視為必是西出妖孽，足以禍國，便遣妖帥調領大軍征剿西岐。 西伯侯姬昌第二子名曰姬發，出世時天空出現異象，百姓皆稱其為未來聖主。姬昌算易知悉姬發有九九之命格危在旦夕，便挺險施行九鼎奇法，卻因妖帥與九大護衛殺入，反成九五至尊之數。大祭司見弄巧成拙，建請紂王宣召姬發上京面聖，藉機要將姬發煉製靈人，代替護國祥物，紂王為保王命，想盡辦法不擇手段，導致天怒人怨，因此種下亡國敗運的禍根。 姬發面聖路上，災劫連連，有飄渺城之困，卻因禍得福習得「渾天寶

programme.title: 新霹靂英雄榜第134集
programme.desc: 《新霹靂英雄榜》是一部動作冒險類型的電視劇或電影系列，為霹靂布袋戲的新一代作品。故事背景設定在一個神祕的武林世界，充滿了武術、魔法和神祕力量。故事圍繞著一羣英雄人物展開，他們各自擁有獨特的技能和身世背景。他們將面臨來自黑暗勢力和邪惡組織的威脅，必須團結一致，通過戰鬥和冒險來守護正義和保護世界的平衡。《新霹靂英雄榜》融合了激烈的打鬥場面、刺激的動作場景和細膩的角色發展，帶給觀眾一場震撼的視覺盛宴。劇情扣人心絃，充滿著驚險、奇幻和神祕的元素，同時也融入了人物之間的情感和義務的探討。這部作品以霹靂布袋戲的獨特風格和特色為基礎，結合了現代特效和技術，將傳統和現代元素相結合，呈現出一個全新的霹靂世界。觀

programme.title: 喝酒吧！笨蛋第10集
programme.desc: 故事講述曾是國際調酒大賽冠軍的調酒師阿榮，風光一時的他，卻因意外失去嗅覺跌入人生谷底，夜夜買醉、渾渾噩噩。某次，他遇上一名亂入酒吧的小混混，對方竟用店內食材亂調「怪味酒」，甚至加入「特殊液體」作為神祕原料，阿榮一飲而下竟奇蹟般恢復味覺。而好友 Leo因投資有成，出資買下酒吧後，阿榮重新站回吧檯，為每位登門客人調製專屬酒品，也看遍人生百態。

programme.title: 超完美狗保姆第1集

programme.title: 臺灣食堂第5集
programme.desc: 多元融合，煎煮炒炸，酸甜苦辣滋味豐富，是臺菜特色。臺菜也因體系龐雜，看得到外來「血緣」，以致若認真詢問哪些菜纔算正宗臺菜，相信沒有幾個人能說的明白。臺灣究竟有哪些值得推上國際的美食？什麼是最能代表臺灣的「臺菜」？

programme.title: 列車人生第6集
programme.desc: 透過列車，看見世界，也看見自己。在人生的旅途中，我們都曾上過不同的列車：有些通往遠方，有些帶你回家。每一趟旅程，都讓人遇見風景，也遇見自己。每一集不僅是一段火車旅程，更是一場「人生練習曲」。有人尋找回家的路，有人學會告別過去，也有人在途中學會擁抱未知。

programme.title: 森之歌第1集
programme.desc: 從海岸到高山，從新生的幼苗到千年的神木，它們以不同的面貌矗立在島嶼上，在森林中，潮來潮往的生命輪迴以及自然界的幻化，無時無刻都在發生，就像是一聲聲美妙的歌詠，不斷的傳唱在大地之間…這是一部紀錄臺灣森林興衰，並探討森林與人之間互動因果的紀錄片，「森之歌」將呈現臺灣的森林生態系之美，先住民在山林中的生命智慧，臺灣山林環境變遷與水土流失的因果關係，以及目前正為森林保育與未來發展而努力的人，共同譜寫的生命組曲 。

programme.title: 下課花路米-博物館大驚奇第5集
programme.desc: 《博物館大驚奇》，從自然的核心出發，發展出8個人與自然間，互為關連的博物館深度之旅。

programme.title: 臺灣食堂第9集
programme.desc: 多元融合，煎煮炒炸，酸甜苦辣滋味豐富，是臺菜特色。臺菜也因體系龐雜，看得到外來「血緣」，以致若認真詢問哪些菜纔算正宗臺菜，相信沒有幾個人能說的明白。臺灣究竟有哪些值得推上國際的美食？什麼是最能代表臺灣的「臺菜」？

programme.title: 全球動物冒險王第5季:第9集

programme.title: 阮三個第3集

programme.title: 一字千金第21集
programme.desc: 《一字千金》是臺灣公共電視文化事業基金會監制、全能製作公司製作、天衍互動技術協助、以漢字為主題並體驗中華文字之美的益智競賽節目，號稱“電視史上結合App、最緊張、最刺激的文字書寫比賽”，並曾榮獲第50屆金鐘獎綜合節目獎。由曾國城擔任主持人。節目中所有書寫字體均以傳統漢字版本為主，其標準為中華民國教育部所頒布的標準楷書，並以常用國字標準字體表、次常用國字標準字體表收錄的常用漢字為範疇。至於答案的認定，則以教育部重編國語辭典修訂本為最終依據。

programme.title: 歐吉桑騎士-阿順阿忠的中年危機第7集
programme.desc: 星馬影帝李銘順、李銘忠兄弟檔首次合體，要騎著臺灣最常見的「摩托車」，成為名副其實的「騎士」，用最接地氣的角度，重新認識待超過十年的臺灣，探索寶島可愛的人文風景，也找尋自己中年危機的答案。

programme.title: 樹人大冒險第1集
programme.desc: 尤瑪想去市集欣賞漂亮的首飾，但是哥哥尤命顧慮她的安危，嚴格禁止她亂跑。被限制行動的妹妹非常生氣，甚至用力咬了哥哥一口，甩開哥哥跑進了森林裡的山洞。尤瑪和尤命進入了樹人世界，而這次哥哥尤命卻被魔法命中，變成了「樹人」！憂心的妹妹只好擔起拯救哥哥的責任，踏上異世界的驚奇之旅！為了讓哥哥恢復原狀，他們必須從「鐵鋸魔」手中拯救「花精公主」；在這趟冒險的旅程，尤瑪也將深深瞭解哥哥對自己的愛。

programme.title: zalan.見識南島第9季:第118集
programme.desc: 《 ZALAN見識南島 》將聚焦於百年來臺灣與世界南島語族在歷史變遷中被捕捉與珍藏的珍貴畫面，透過解讀與延伸舊照片或舊影片中所呈現南島語族的生活與文化樣貌，探究其中的文化演進與所包含的知識內容，並討論它們對當代社會的啟示和價值。

programme.title: 樹說新語第5集
programme.desc: 透過黃荊，為客家先民所倚賴的樹種，探索它們數千年來和客家族羣互動的歷史。

programme.title: 細細山路私密達第2集
programme.desc: 節目邀請五位臺韓主持人，橫跨不同世代與領域，在山路旅程中共同走讀客家古道。這不只是一次文化體驗，更是一場跨文化的理解行動，希望觀眾可以和藝人一起，用最慢的方式，去靠近一個族羣的生命節奏。在古道上，走出一種新的理解，也讓那些藏在山路裡的客家故事，再一次被看見、被傾聽、被記住。

programme.title: 我把旅行變成一道菜第4集
programme.desc: 《我把旅行變成一道菜》是一個獨特的旅遊節目，節目主持人將以烹飪的方式，將旅行的經歷和感受轉化為美食的創作。每集節目中，主持人會前往不同的目的地，體驗當地文化、美景和人文風情，並在回來後將所見所聞融入菜餚的烹飪過程中，創造出一道道獨特而有趣的美食。這個節目旨在將旅行和美食相結合，帶給觀眾視覺和味覺的雙重享受，同時也讓觀眾感受到旅行和飲食之間的深刻聯繫。

programme.title: 音樂關鍵字第1集
programme.desc: 生活裡無處不在的聲音，其實是最浪漫的科學—換個方式「尞／聊」音樂。提到音樂，多數人總以為那是右腦的事，是抽象的知覺、感性的領悟，但其實音樂也有它很左腦、很理性、很科學的一面。生活裡無處不在的聲音，其實是最浪漫的科學。

programme.title: 音樂關鍵字第2集
programme.desc: 生活裡無處不在的聲音，其實是最浪漫的科學—換個方式「尞／聊」音樂。提到音樂，多數人總以為那是右腦的事，是抽象的知覺、感性的領悟，但其實音樂也有它很左腦、很理性、很科學的一面。生活裡無處不在的聲音，其實是最浪漫的科學。

programme.title: 八音迎新春第9集
programme.desc: 客家八音是客家器樂音樂的代表，原是民間小型吹打樂的一種，隨著時代的變遷，功能逐漸擴充，從原為祭祀迎賓等典禮而服務的音樂，到演為供給娛樂欣賞等喜氣事情的音樂演奏或伴奏音樂，甚至現今亦被使用於喪事場合的演奏。

programme.desc: 打八音

programme.title: 學學嘴學學鼻第13集
programme.desc: 「學學嘴學學鼻」與孩子們唱唱跳跳學客語，期望從學齡前幼兒到國高中生，皆能從中找到語言、文化的趣味，或學習從不同觀點看世界。

programme.title: WAWA哇！第2集
programme.desc: 「哇！」是孩子來到世界上的第一聲哭啼，「WAWA哇！」是孩子接觸大自然所發出的讚嘆。 幼兒戶外紀實節目《WAWA哇！》公視、 臺語臺、客家臺、原視四臺聯合製作

programme.title: 山歌唱來鬧連連第92集
programme.desc: 為保存山歌藝術，節目將邀請客家山歌界國寶級人物，以及各界山歌的翹楚蒞臨演出，使客家山歌藝術有更細膩的保存。本節目期許讓觀眾看見、聽見客家山歌之美，進而引發學習興趣，使得山歌不再只是束之高閣的藝術，而是人人瑯瑯上口的生活歌謠。

programme.title: 奧林p客第1602集
programme.desc: 在新的對話中，主持人和機器人阿藍妹將增加科技互動的元素。參賽孩子們將扮演小博士的角色，從各種主題和發明中學習現代科學和未來科技。每一集將以「一大六小」的競賽形式進行，並引入四選一的卡牌抽選機制，讓孩子們學習團隊合作，並在面對不同意見時學會溝通和做出抉擇。

programme.title: ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕(大埔腔)第160集
programme.desc: 朋友聚在一起時，總是會有對話、爭吵、歡笑，以及許多有趣的故事。這個節目「ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕」，描述的就是四個好朋友間的種種經歷和冒險故事。

programme.title: ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕(饒平腔)第161集
programme.desc: 「ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕」是一個以四位好朋友為主角的故事，他們在一起時會有對話、爭吵、歡笑，並共同創造出許多故事情節。

programme.title: 八戒-決戰未來(多元語特別版)第1集
programme.desc: 八戒是一個有著街頭智慧，但卻常常把事情搞砸的魯蛇。沒想到這一天，他居然被選進了象徵成功人士的新世界，他終於能讓奶奶為他感到驕傲了；但是高興沒多久，才被告知這一切是搞錯了。不想再被當作笑話的八戒，接受了牛魔王的祕密約定，他臥底在三藏的團隊中竊取資訊，協助牛魔王的永生計劃，以換取進入新世界的祕密管道。就在八戒成功完成任務的同時，才發現牛魔王的永生計畫，將會奪走許多人的壽命，其中，居然還包括自己的奶奶。他必須付出全力與夥伴一起阻止這一切，救回三藏、奶奶與所有人。

programme.title: 拉拉雜雜有土伯第26集
programme.desc: (2020)「拉拉雜雜」意指各式各樣、玲瑯滿目。「拉拉雜雜有土伯」內容為客家電視獨創，代表各項客家文化的客家寶寶為主角，打造一個網紅經紀公司，每一個客家寶寶都是一位YouTuber，他們以客家疊字來詮釋多樣又有趣...

programme.title: 昆蟲捉迷藏第24集
programme.desc: 我們將帶您重新認識昆蟲世界。昆蟲是與人類最親近的生物之一，我們曾經與它們有過親密的接觸。然而，隨著年紀增長和忙碌的生活，我們可能已經遺忘了這些回憶，甚至因為對昆蟲的陌生和不瞭解而留下了負面印象。透過重新認識一隻蝴蝶幼蟲，我們將帶您認識葉子、花朵、樹木、森林以及生命的蛻變。這將改變您對生命的看法，並激發您對自然的興趣和

programme.title: 麻吉樂園LINE TOWN第43集
programme.desc: 一個無奇不有的溫馨小鎮「LINE TOWN」，鎮上住著許多歡樂、開心的LINE卡通明星：沉默溫和的熊大、開朗時髦的兔兔、隨心所欲的饅頭人、自戀的詹姆士、愛漂亮的潔西卡、常常幫大家解決事情的莎莉、以及害羞內向的雷納德等人，在LINE TOWN發生了一連串有趣的大小事。

programme.title: 麻吉樂園LINE TOWN第44集
programme.desc: 一個無奇不有的溫馨小鎮「LINE TOWN」，鎮上住著許多歡樂、開心的LINE卡通明星：沉默溫和的熊大、開朗時髦的兔兔、隨心所欲的饅頭人、自戀的詹姆士、愛漂亮的潔西卡、常常幫大家解決事情的莎莉、以及害羞內向的雷納德等人，在LINE TOWN發生了一連串有趣的大小事。

programme.title: 練習生，衝一波!第53集
programme.desc: 「練習生衝一波」是一個真實的實境節目，主持人將扮演志願者練習生的角色，每集將前往不同的公益社福團體進行志願服務。透過全心參與、實際行動、觀察和對話，我們希望讓年輕人在每次「生命影響生命」的旅程中，深入瞭解各種弱勢族羣的真實情況、心情和需求，並從中體會到相互尊重、包容和奉獻的力量和價值。

programme.title: 當晝新聞第52集
programme.desc: 《當晝新聞》是一個日間新聞節目，提供即時、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題。這個節目專注於在白天時段向觀眾傳遞當下最重要的新聞資訊，讓觀眾隨時掌握時事動向，並對眾多議題保持關注和理解。無論是政治動盪、經濟變化，或者社會事件和文化創新，這個節目都將為觀眾帶來最及時的報導和解析。

programme.title: 客客客棧第7集
programme.desc: 提到「客家」，你會聯想到什麼？硬頸精神、勤勞節儉、客家美食，還是滿天飛舞的桐花？而「客家」，又是怎麼來的呢？又有什麼樣有趣的小故事？

programme.title: 初心。登場第11集
programme.desc: 延續「客家製譟」音樂盛典品牌，2025年結合實境拍攝全新打造「初心。登場」系列節目，團隊跨越近一年時間紀錄八組音樂人回歸創作初心，挑戰前所未有的「第一次」登臺。從平均年齡最年輕的樂團到搖滾天后，從獨立另類到流行經典，囊括金曲得主、經典唱將、演唱團體、亮眼新秀，多樣曲風加上最感動的創作初心，聯手專業團隊打造出耗資千萬的演唱會！

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子-友情萬歲第1集
programme.desc: 故事圍繞著小丸子以及其家人和同學展開，有關於親情、友誼等，或是一些生活小事，但當中有笑有淚，令人回想起童年的稚氣。

programme.title: 音樂關鍵字第10集
programme.desc: 生活裡無處不在的聲音，其實是最浪漫的科學—換個方式「尞／聊」音樂。提到音樂，多數人總以為那是右腦的事，是抽象的知覺、感性的領悟，但其實音樂也有它很左腦、很理性、很科學的一面。生活裡無處不在的聲音，其實是最浪漫的科學。

programme.title: 吉日良辰客家封第15集
programme.desc: 以一道道料理為起點，透過食材的生產關係、食物的料理過程乃至廚師的烹飪目的，《吉日良辰客家封》試著以人與料理的故事，建立與客家概念的連結與對照，勾勒客家飲食多元豐富的面向。

programme.title: 暗夜新聞第52集
programme.desc: 暗夜客話新聞是全國唯一主播、記者以全客語發音的新聞頻道，並 詳實顯示字幕，除了著眼於「客家觀點」的重要新聞議題、呈現客家生活 習俗與傳統文化之外，更盡力發掘社會各階層客家鄉親的故事。暗夜客話新聞針對四節新聞播出鏡面，以桐花、藍衫等各種不同主題的客家元素為基礎，作全面的視覺設計，讓收視大眾們能夠耳目一新、零時差的掌握，最具客家觀點的新聞呈現。

programme.title: 小O事件簿第167集
programme.desc: 為了讓大人小孩都能從兒童的角度，看待與大家有切身關係的新聞事件，客家電視臺推出由小學生參與採訪與播報的兒童新聞節目《小O事件簿》，希望提供一個全新的討論空間，讓大人跟小孩一起關心身邊發生的事情。

programme.desc: 為了讓大人小孩都能從兒童的角度，看待與大家有切身關係的新聞事件，客家電視臺推出由小學生參與採訪與播報的兒童新聞節目《小O事件簿》，希望提供一個全新的討論空間，讓大人跟小孩一起關心身邊發生的事情。

programme.title: 當晝新聞第53集
programme.desc: 《當晝新聞》是一個日間新聞節目，提供即時、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題。這個節目專注於在白天時段向觀眾傳遞當下最重要的新聞資訊，讓觀眾隨時掌握時事動向，並對眾多議題保持關注和理解。無論是政治動盪、經濟變化，或者社會事件和文化創新，這個節目都將為觀眾帶來最及時的報導和解析。

programme.title: 客客客棧第8集
programme.desc: 提到「客家」，你會聯想到什麼？硬頸精神、勤勞節儉、客家美食，還是滿天飛舞的桐花？而「客家」，又是怎麼來的呢？又有什麼樣有趣的小故事？

programme.title: 鬧熱打擂臺第507集
programme.desc: 以歌唱擂臺對抗賽的方式，讓客家鄉親有更多表演的機會，從客家說演到客家流行歌，展現出他們最有魅力的一面。

programme.title: 啊喔！最kiang駐村小隊第5集
programme.desc: 藝人們合體組成「最Kiang小隊」前往苗栗－素有長壽村稱號的獅潭鄉駐點一個月，他們最大的任務是讓更多的人親近客家文化特色，四個各懷專長的隊員空降客家莊，能夠成功完成在地村民交辦的任務，還是成了＂天兵＂在村內不斷的出糗呢？

programme.title: 吉日良辰客家封第16集
programme.desc: 以一道道料理為起點，透過食材的生產關係、食物的料理過程乃至廚師的烹飪目的，《吉日良辰客家封》試著以人與料理的故事，建立與客家概念的連結與對照，勾勒客家飲食多元豐富的面向。

programme.title: 拉拉雜雜有土伯第11集
programme.desc: (2020)「拉拉雜雜」意指各式各樣、玲瑯滿目。「拉拉雜雜有土伯」內容為客家電視獨創，代表各項客家文化的客家寶寶為主角，打造一個網紅經紀公司，每一個客家寶寶都是一位YouTuber，他們以客家疊字來詮釋多樣又有趣...

programme.title: 練習生，衝一波!第55集

programme.title: 恐龍化石挖寶人第2季:第6集
programme.desc: 在蒙大拿州，克雷頓在距離原先發現的三角龍頭骨不遠處又發現一個三角龍頭骨，經過挖掘，發現這個頭骨並不完整。在懷俄明州，哈里斯波蘭團隊繼續陸續挖出他們暱稱為布魯託的角龍，但是測估體型尺寸關鍵的股骨卻一直沒有找到。艾倫在遺址內挖到一片完整的甲龍盾片，隨後又挖出一根比他們預期的短上至少30公分的股骨，這隻角龍的謎團更大了。此時傳來暴龍史丹拍賣出高達三千兩百萬美元的天價，令麥克出售牛仔暴龍的信心大增。在新墨西哥州，在挖掘猛瑪象牙過程中發現了越來越多骨頭，讓安德烈備感壓力。因為如果不在下一場暴雨來之前挖出所有化石，遭雨水滲入的化石將很可能整個瓦解。

programme.title: 舊礦區新財路第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 戴維擁有科羅拉多州愛達荷泉市外一個推定價值達20億美元的礦坑，他不但想挖出坑內的金銀銅鋅等各種礦物，還在山下蓋了選礦場，除供自家礦坑使用，也打算接其他礦坑的生意。儘管各項設備與人力幾乎都具備了，窘困的現金卻讓整個運作缺臨門一腳。艾力克斯和凱文協助戴維將礦坑口一棟有百年以上裡史的廠房修復，讓機器有放置與運作的地方，讓工人有飲食和休息的地方，並且鋪設一條鐵道工搬運車來回廠房與礦坑。更棒的是，他們和戴維談下了五年，每2.5%產值，外加可以使用選礦場的條件。戴維則在兩人協助下順利讓挖礦與選礦場的事業開始進行，初期便獲得豐碩成果。
